cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remember my lesson about giving a garden one focal point. Can we agree the pond should be ours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have a tree, not a pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're comparing the options. I've had the tree removed; now you can judge the space properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You cut it down before asking me? The stump is still there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly the detail I trained you to notice. Let me have your yes to the pond, and I'll tell the grinder to finish the job.
